Figure 1:IntentFluxturns a verifiable source task into a multi-turn
interaction with controlled intent edits. The agent observes only
the dialogue; the oracle applies the edit plan to obtain the final active
intentG⋆G^{\star}, and the original grader evaluates the final output or action.

Figure 2:StateForgefolds an evolving dialogue into an explicit active
state for external generation. The same state-update behavior supports
two transfer paths: on-policy distillation to a lightweight tracker and
thinking distillation to a standalone agent.
